title: OMEGA-Avatar: One-shot Modeling of 360{\deg} Gaussian Avatars
abstract: arXiv:2602.11693v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Creating high-fidelity, animatable 3D avatars from a single image remains a formidable challenge. We identified three desirable attributes of avatar generation: 1) the method should be feed-forward, 2) model a 360{\deg} full-head, and 3) should be animation-ready. However, current work addresses only two of the three points simultaneously. To address these limitations, we propose OMEGA-Avatar, the first feed-forward framework that simultaneously generates a generalizable, 360{\deg}-complete, and animatable 3D Gaussian head from a single image. Starting from a feed-forward and animatable framework, we address the 360{\deg} full-head avatar generation problem with two novel components. First, to overcome poor hair modeling in full-head avatar generation, we introduce a semantic-aware mesh deformation module that integrates multi-view normals to optimize a FLAME head with hair while preserving its topology structure. translated_title: OMEGA-Avatar：360度高斯化身的一次性建模
translated_abstract: 从单张图像创建高保真、可动画的3D化身仍然是一项艰巨的挑战。我们确定了化身生成的三个理想属性：1）方法应当是前馈式的，2）能够建模360°完整头部，3）应当具备可动画性。然而，现有工作只能同时满足其中两点。为解决这些局限，我们提出了OMEGA-Avatar，这是首个能够从单张图像同时生成可泛化、360°完整且可动画的3D高斯头部的前馈式框架。以前馈式可动画框架为基础，我们通过两个新颖组件来解决360°完整头部化身生成问题。首先，为克服完整头部化身生成中头发建模不佳的问题，我们引入了一个语义感知的网格变形模块，该模块融合多视图法线来优化带头发的FLAME头部，同时保持其拓扑结构。其次，为了……
tldr: 提出OMEGA-Avatar——首个前馈式框架，可从单张图像同时生成可泛化、360°完整且可动画的3D高斯头部化身，并通过融合多视图法线的语义感知网格变形模块解决了完整头部化身生成中头发建模不佳的问题。
en_tdlr: OMEGA-Avatar is the first feed-forward framework that generates generalizable, 360°-complete, and animatable 3D Gaussian head avatars from a single image, introducing a semantic-aware mesh deformation module with multi-view normals to overcome poor hair modeling in full-head avatar generation.
